title: Life Plan Benefits Bulletin: Care-Point Band Tolerance for Respite Guests
content:
For a guest on an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, the band tolerance is the number of care points by which a nurse assessment's care points on record must exceed the highest score of the band below the new stay type. Life Plan households holding an Entrance Fee Agreement have a smaller tolerance.

**Benefit.** The band tolerance is zero points (0 points) for a guest who holds an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare plan, two points (2 points) for a guest who holds an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a fee-for-service plan, and five points (5 points) for any other guest.

The records read are the guest's Entrance Fee Agreement, whether it is in occupied status, and the contract type of its plan: the LifeCare plans are lifecare contracts and the LifeChoice plans are fee-for-service contracts.

## Tolerance by holding

| Guest's Entrance Fee Agreement | Contract type of the plan | Band tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Occupied | Lifecare (LifeCare Declining Balance Plan, LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan) | 0 points |
| Occupied | Fee-for-service (LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% and 90% Refundable Plans) | 2 points |
| None occupied (none held, or held as reserved, terminated, refund scheduled, closed, rescinded or cancelled) | — | 5 points |

## Illustrations (hypothetical assessments)

An assessment places a guest in the Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care), whose band below tops out at 25 points, with 28 care points: an excess of 3 points.

| Guest | Band tolerance | Excess of 3 points at least the tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Occupied agreement on a LifeCare plan | 0 points | Yes |
| Occupied agreement on a LifeChoice plan | 2 points | Yes |
| No occupied agreement | 5 points | No |
